record.question: Which of the following vaccine is NOT given at birth?
record.explanation: Answer C: Pentavalent. In India’s national immunization schedule, BCG, OPV-0, and hepatitis B birth dose are given at birth; pentavalent vaccine starts later. Source/context note: Schedules can be updated; this answer follows the Indian schedule relevant to the exam. Reference: https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Universal%20Immunization%20Programme%20-%20Operational%20Guidelines.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
